question: The number of prime numbers lying between 374 and 384 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Numbers between 374 and 384 are 375, 376, 377, 378, 379, 380, 381, 382, and 383.

Eliminate all even numbers: 376, 378, 380, 382.

Eliminate numbers ending in 5: 375.

Check remaining odd numbers: 377 = 13 × 29 (not prime), 381 = 3 × 127 (not prime).

Only **379** and **383** are prime numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given range: numbers strictly between **374** and **384**.

List of integers in this range: {375, 376, 377, 378, 379, 380, 381, 382, 383}

To check if a number N is prime, we test divisibility by prime numbers up to √N ≈ 19.5 (i.e., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19).

⇒ 375: Divisible by 5 (not prime)

⇒ 376, 378, 380, 382: Divisible by 2 (not prime)

⇒ 377: 377 ÷ 13 = 29 (not prime)

⇒ 379: Not divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 (**Prime**)

⇒ 381: Divisible by 3 (Sum of digits 3+8+1 = 12) (not prime)

⇒ 383: Not divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 (**Prime**)

⇒ Total prime numbers = 2 (which are 379 and 383)

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number Definition

A natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

Primality Test Rule

To determine if a number N is prime, check its divisibility by all prime numbers less than or equal to √N.

Sieve of Eratosthenes

An ancient and highly efficient algorithm used to find all prime numbers up to any given limit by systematically marking the multiples of each prime.</p
